title: EduEval: A Hierarchical Cognitive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Chinese Education

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using multiple-choice questions that simulate real-world ethical dilemmas in school settings to assess the model's normative reasoning regarding classroom equity, grading fairness, and professional teacher bias.

Comparing zero-shot and few-shot accuracy across different educational levels (e.g., primary vs. high school) to identify performance disparities resulting from the overrepresentation of advanced academic material in pre-training corpora.
